title: Professional staff, affordable, fun and romantic scooter ride around Barcelona
text:
Staff was friendly and professional. 
Staff spoke English, French, Spanish and Arabic. 
Excellent professional system of renting out vehicles and advising where to go. 
Highly highly highly recommend renting a Vespa or scooter to make your stay in Barcelona fun and eliminate all the exhaustion of walking around even though I’m athletic and love to walk.
 You can visit all the major sites like Park Guell at the top of the mountain and when you arrive walk around feeling energized. 
You’re in total control of where to go and when and there’s always parking for scooters all over the city.
